question: On which date did the Department of Posts launch the philately scholarship scheme in 2024?
solution: The correct answer is __**24 August 2024**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The Department of Posts has launched a philately scholarship scheme under the Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana to promote philately among students from Class VI to IX.
